{"lean_source": "import Std

namespace EditContract

inductive EditKind where
  | boundary
  | overlap

inductive Result where
  | ok (text : String)
  | err (kind : EditKind) (edit : Nat)

def valid (text : String) (edits : List (Nat × Nat × String)) : Prop :=
  let n := text.utf16Length
  let rec check (i : Nat) (prevEnd : Nat) : Bool :=
    if i < edits.length then
      let (s, e, _) := edits[i]!
      if s > e then false
      else if e > n then false
      else if s < prevEnd then false
      else check (i + 1) e
    else true
  check 0 0

def solve (text : String) (edits : List (Nat × Nat × String)) : Result :=
  let n := text.utf16Length
  let rec check (i : Nat) (prevEnd : Nat) : Result :=
    if i < edits.length then
      let (s, e, _) := edits[i]!
      if s > e then Result.err EditKind.boundary i
      else if e > n then Result.err EditKind.boundary i
      else if s < prevEnd then Result.err EditKind.overlap i
      else check (i + 1) e
    else
      let rec apply (i : Nat) (acc : String) : String :=
        if i < edits.length then
          let (s, e, t) := edits[i]!
          let before := acc.take s
          let rest := acc.drop e
          apply (i + 1) (before ++ t ++ rest)
        else acc
      Result.ok (apply 0 text)
  check 0 0

theorem thm_boundary (text : String) (edits : List (Nat × Nat × String)) (i : Nat) :
  i < edits.length →
  let (s, e, _) := edits[i]!
  s > e ∨ e > text.utf16Length →
  solve text edits = Result.err EditKind.boundary i := by sorry

theorem thm_overlap (text : String) (edits : List (Nat × Nat × String)) (i : Nat) :
  i < edits.length →
  let (s, e, _) := edits[i]!
  s ≤ e → e ≤ text.utf16Length →
  (∀ j, j < i → let (sj, ej, _) := edits[j]!; sj ≤ ej ∧ ej ≤ text.utf16Length ∧ sj ≥ (if j = 0 then 0 else (edits[j-1]!).2)) →
  s < (if i = 0 then 0 else (edits[i-1]!).2) →
  solve text edits = Result.err EditKind.overlap i := by sorry

theorem thm_success (text : String) (edits : List (Nat × Nat × String)) :
  valid text edits →
  ∃ r, solve text edits = Result.ok r := by sorry

theorem non_vacuity :
  (∃ (text : String) (edits : List (Nat × Nat × String)), valid text edits) ∧
  (∃ (text : String) (edits : List (Nat × Nat × String)) (i : Nat), i < edits.length ∧ let (s, e, _) := edits[i]!; s > e ∨ e > text.utf16Length) := by sorry

end EditContract",
